news.title: Lumbini and Sudurpaschim to open Season 3
news.summary: The reported schedule opens with Lumbini Lions against Sudurpaschim Royals on October 26. The final is scheduled for November 21.

news.title: The next chapter has its dates
news.summary: Season 3 is scheduled for October 26–November 21. Follow the build-up here, alongside the evidence from the first two seasons.

news.title: 52 players retained ahead of the new season
news.summary: Retention decisions shape the next campaign. Historical team associations on this site should not be read as confirmed Season 3 squads.
